labels.name: Stratum granulosum
labels.function: Layer that is absent in a psoriatic plaque

labels.name: Stratum basale
labels.function: Deepest epidermal layer, lining the rete and papillae

labels.name: Parakeratotic scale
labels.function: Nuclei retained in the top layer; seen clinically as silvery scale

labels.name: Munro microabscess
labels.function: Neutrophil cluster within the parakeratotic layer

labels.name: Acanthosis
labels.function: Epidermal thickening from keratinocyte hyperproliferation

labels.name: Elongated rete peg
labels.function: Epidermal extension down into the dermis, lengthened in psoriasis

labels.name: Dilated papillary capillary
labels.function: Superficial vessel that bleeds pinpoint when scale is picked off

labels.name: Suprapapillary thinning
labels.function: Thin layer of epidermis left above each papilla tip

labels.name: Immune cell infiltrate
labels.function: T cells and macrophages infiltrating the skin

labels.name: Dendritic cell
labels.function: Activated antigen-presenting cell that starts the cascade

labels.name: IL-23
labels.function: Target of guselkumab and risankizumab; also links skin to IBD

labels.name: Th17 cell
labels.function: T-helper subset releasing keratinocyte-stimulating cytokines

labels.name: IL-17
labels.function: Target of secukinumab and ixekizumab; blockade risks candidiasis

labels.name: IL-22
labels.function: Second T-helper cytokine pushing epidermal proliferation

labels.name: TNF-alpha
labels.function: Made by other immune cells; blocked by adalimumab or etanercept

labels.name: Keratinocytes
labels.function: Rapid turnover causes acanthosis and silvery-scaled plaques

labels.name: Nail pitting
labels.function: Small depressions in the plate; a CASPAR nail-dystrophy point

labels.name: Onycholysis
labels.function: Plate lifting off its bed at the free edge

labels.name: Yellow-brown discoloration
labels.function: Color change of the nail plate in nail psoriasis

labels.name: Distal interphalangeal joint
labels.function: Joint predominantly affected in one of five PsA patterns

labels.name: Dactylitis
labels.function: Inflammatory swelling of an entire digit; a CASPAR point

labels.name: Enthesitis
labels.function: Inflammation where a tendon inserts into bone
